biotools.summary: sCCIgen is a simulator for generating high-fidelity spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) data, specifically designed for studying cell-cell interactions. The tool preserves transcriptomic and spatial characteristics and provides key interaction features to facilitate method development and benchmarking.
